single-purpose-function.ask: This function does more than one job, or mixes levels of abstraction.

query-has-side-effects.ask: A function named like a query (get, is, has, find, count) changes state or performs I/O.

comment-restates-code.ask: A comment in this function restates what the next line does instead of a non-obvious constraint or why.

anonymous-argument-bundle.ask: Arguments are grouped into an anonymous dict, tuple or list that is not a named domain type.

revalidates-parsed-input.ask: This function re-validates a value that its type or caller already guarantees.

name-omits-unit.ask: A name holds a quantity with a unit, or a flag, and the name does not say which unit or is not a question.

primitive-for-invariant.ask: A raw primitive carries a value with validation rules or behavior that belongs to a value object.
